text:
olivia: Quick QA — after the TF apply to staging (PR #8423) the inference service's NodePort changed and our NLB healthchecks started failing. Also seeing Gateway SecretBinding errors: 'secret not found'. Anyone else hit this?

sam: I glanced at the apply, deploy-bot reported success but there was a small diff. Pinging @raj to eyeball.

deploy-bot: terraform apply complete: 6 resources changed (2 added, 1 changed, 3 destroyed) — plan id: plan-2026-03-18-01

raj: Can you paste `kubectl describe svc inference-svc -n staging` and the Gateway/SecretBinding error text? Also did the helm values remove a pinned nodePort?

olivia: Here's the svc describe and the Gateway error (copied):

```
Name:                     inference-svc
Namespace:                staging
Type:                     NodePort
IP:                       10.240.3.12
Port:                     grpc  8080/TCP
TargetPort:               8080/TCP
NodePort:                 grpc  32080/TCP
Annotations:              service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: "nlb"
                          external-traffic-policy: Cluster

Events:                   <none>

--- Gateway logs ---
Error: SecretBinding reconciliation failed: referenced secret 'inference-tls' not found in namespace 'gateway-system'
```

sam: Looks like the secret lives in `staging` but the Gateway expects it in `gateway-system` (or needs a SecretBinding that points to a cross-namespace secret).

kevin: I think the recent TF/helm change removed the SecretBinding resource (there was a rename earlier). Also I noticed the helm chart stopped setting `values.service.nodePort` so k8s auto-allocated a different NodePort. That explains the port drift.

ana: (typo) sorry, meant ana: Two quick notes: 1) NLB healthchecks default to hitting the NodePort unless we set a healthCheck port via annotations — if nodePort moves k8s endpoints may not line up with LB expectations. 2) Gateway API SecretBinding requires the secret to be in the Gateway's namespace unless you use a SecretReference via SecretBinding object — we used to create that via infra automation.

raj: Short checklist to fix:
- ensure secret is accessible to gateway (either copy it into gateway-system or re-create the SecretBinding that points to staging/inference-tls)
- pin the nodePort in helm values (so TF/helm doesn't let k8s reassign)
- consider setting `externalTrafficPolicy: Local` or an explicit healthcheck port annotation so NLB checks backend pods instead of the cluster proxy

sam: I can do 1) re-create SecretBinding in gateway-system pointing to staging/inference-tls and 2) open a tiny PR to pin nodePort=32080 in the chart values. Which should go first?

olivia: Please do 1 then 2. I'll open a follow-up PR to add a CI guard that flags removal of node_port in helm values. Also add a short comment in the TF PR template to call out SecretBinding changes. :thumbsup:

raj: :eyes: pinging infra team for an RBAC check — if we start copying secrets across namespaces we need to validate service-account roles used by the secret-sync job.

kevin: FYI, small mitigation if we need immediate restore: re-create the svc with `nodePort: 32080` (quick patch) and roll the gateway pods after SecretBinding created. Not ideal but buys time.

olivia: Thanks all — will follow up with PR links shortly.

sam: I'll send the PRs in the next 20m and tag reviewers.

deploy-bot: deploy job queued: staging/inference/republish (will run after PR merge)

olivia: resolved? will close thread after PR merges.
